BiblicalUsage: Agartal is a basin — a broad, shallow vessel of gold or silver for the temple service. Cyrus counts out thirty chargers of gold and a thousand of silver for the returning exiles, and Ezra weighs out twenty basons of gold, worth a thousand drams, for the journey to Jerusalem.
TheologicalSignificance: I read it as it stands — a plain term in a particular verse — and I won't make it bear a weight Scripture never put on it; in this case, the verse is Ezra 1:9.
